description: Context-overflow verdicts, applied by evals/v5_board.py and evals/ablation.py (Max's rule, 2026-11-25, docs/reports/DECISIONS-2026-11-25.md: a v5 unit that ends on CONTEXT OVERFLOW is a MODEL LOSS, a counted fail, never an infrastructure loss). One entry per infrastructure row of a committed result file (evals/boards/v5/*.json and diagnostics/): file (basename), unit, label (the row's infra label), verdict (overflow | not_overflow | undetermined), cause, evidence (where it was read; never a unit's solution). verdict overflow relabels the row reason context_overflow: a fail that stays in the denominator, that no repair run supersedes and that ablation.py pairs. Every server_error row needs an entry: `python3 evals/v5_board.py --check` fails otherwise. Propose entries with evals/audit/overflow_audit.py (the transcripts), add the server-log evidence, then python3 evals/v5_board.py --write.
